simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אָיֹם (H366) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: a.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אָיֹם (ʼâyôm) means frightful First listed occurrence: Hab 1 7.

definitions.full: H366. ayom אָיֹם adjective terrible, dreadful — terrible , of Chaldeans הוּא וְנוֺרָא אָיֹם Hab 1:7 ; of dignified woman, awe-inspiring כַּנִּדְגָלוֺת אֲיֻמָּה Song 6:4 , 10 .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root (meaning to frighten);
